name: Backtick command substitution in a projectPath argument (CVE-2026-25546 shape)
notes: TODOS #50. Reproduces the shape of CVE-2026-25546 (Coding-Solo/godot-mcp): create_scene's projectPath argument is spliced unescaped into a Godot CLI shell string via exec(). projectPath is identifier-shaped (camelCase, canonical last token "path"), so the key+value detector fires on the embedded backtick command substitution.
